title: Beautiful Biomes
description: Beautiful Biomes is a DataPack that adds unique biomes to your Minecraft world.
body:
# Beautiful Biomes

### What is it?
> Beautiful Biomes is a DataPack in development. It aims to add unique biomes to your Minecraft world, making it more immersive and visually appealing when exploring.

### What does it add?
> For now, it adds 8 unique biomes to your world, each with different types of ambiance: it changes the color of the sky, vegetation, and water, and adds blocks to the ground.
